BrochureContent.Content: The Hideaway - a coastal home on the edge of the popular Stradbally village with large adjoining paddock!Just 1.5km from the centre of the village, the property has a most unique setting near the turn to Ballyvooney Cove. Standing on 0.67 acres approx, the property has a most scenic location surrounded by rolling green countryside with a large adjoining paddock.Stepping inside via the bright porch, the property is well proportioned throughout. The living room is located to the front of the property and is a fine room with window to the front, fitted stove and double glass doors to the kitchen/dining. This is a bright room with a modern fitted kitchen and windows to the rear garden. The master bedroom is off the living room and is a fine size room while the remaining 2 bedrooms are off the hallway and are both double bedrooms. There is both a shower room and a WC off the hall. A quaint half-door opens to the rear garden. Externally, the property has a private tarmac entrance drive with lockable gates. A sheltered patio area at the front of the property looks out on the sunny private front garden. To the rear, the garden is fully enclosed with timber garden sheds and double gates at the side that connect to the driveway. To the side, there is a large field/paddock with separate farm gate access from the road that is perfect for keeping animals and could have future development potential subject to planning permission. It's convenient location, site size and scenic surrounds makes The Hideaway a unique opportunity in the Stradbally market.

• On the edge of Stradbally village - 1.5km to the square.
  • Close proximity to Ballyvooney Cove.
  • Future further development potential subject to planning.
  • Large paddock to the side with separate gated access.
  • Modern kitchen.
  • Very private gardens to front and rear.
  • Tarmac driveway with lockable gates.
  • Fitted stove in living room.
  • Oil fired central heating.
  • Septic tank and mains water.
